title: Comparison functors and localization factors for flat coefficient restriction
statement: Fix a flat ringed diagram input and a small category $J$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-input]. Write $Q$ for localization of each diagram cochain category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For specified functors $L_B:D(\mathcal A_{V,B})\to D(\mathcal A_{U,B})$ and $F_B:D(\mathcal A_{U,B})\to D(\mathcal A_{V,B})$, $B=R,S$, define comparison data to consist of ordinary natural isomorphisms $b^0:r_UL_S^0\simeq L_R^0r_V$ and $d^0:r_VF_S^0\simeq F_R^0r_U$; functors $\bar r_T:D(\mathcal A_{T,S})\to D(\mathcal A_{T,R})$ and factor isomorphisms $q_T:\bar r_T Q\simeq Qr_T$ for $T=U,V$; and natural isomorphisms $b:\bar r_UL_S\simeq L_R\bar r_V$ and $d:\bar r_VF_S\simeq F_R\bar r_U$. Superscript $0$ denotes the ordinary termwise image functors before localization; the factors use their degreewise functors on complexes.
